messages:
maria_nguyen: FYI nimbus LoRA merge into mistral-7b-q4 produced a weird cold-start stall during smoke.

maria_nguyen: steps to repro: stitch lora -> quantize q4 -> start runtime with kvcache on -> send short prompt -> runtime opens connection but no tokens stream.

maria_nguyen: cmd i ran:\n```\nredwood stitch --base=mistral-7b --lora=nimbus_v2 --out=merged-nimbus && \nredwood quantize --model=merged-nimbus --format=q4 && \nredwood run --model=merged-nimbus-q4 --kvcache=enabled\n```\n

samir_khan: did you see any kvcache warnings in the agent logs? usually mismatch/errors bubble as warnings.

maria_nguyen: yes repeated: "kvcache_index_mismatch: expected 1024, got 1023" and then a hang.

devin_lee: could be tokenizer alignment. Any changes to special tokens or pad token from the LoRA package?

maria_nguyen: found it — nimbus_v2's tokenizer.json sets "pad_token": "<pad>" (id=0) and also has added "additional_special_tokens": ["<customer_ask>"]. base mistral tokenizer had no pad_token and no that special token.

jess_roberts: added special token will shift token ids for suffixes/prefixes. With q4 layout the kvcache expects fixed KV slot mapping per token index. A shift will cause the off-by-one.

samir_khan: two action paths: canonicalize tokenizer during stitch (strip unknown pad or remap special tokens) OR add a runtime compatibility layer that remaps token ids before kvcache indexing. I prefer canonicalization at merge time.

maria_nguyen: quick-eval (500 prompts) shows functional degradation when we let runtime try to remap: 1.2% EM drop, several prompts returned early-termination. Latency +6%.

ci-bot: CI: nimbus-kv-compat (smoke) FAILED — tokenizer-parity-check failed. See: https://ci.redwood/internal/ci/419988

devin_lee: proposal: augment stitch with a --normalize-tokenizer flag that enforces base tokenizer fields (pad_token=null by default, merges additional_special_tokens into reserved metadata). Also emit a warning if token id remap would change token indices.

samir_khan: i'll prototype normalize-tokenizer and add an integration test covering: (a) extra special tokens, (b) pad_token present, (c) token id shift causing kvcache mismatch. Test should assert stable kv indices after stitch.

jess_roberts: timeline? customer wants a smoke deploy today.

samir_khan: i'll try to push a branch in ~2 hours. If we can't ship, fallback is to deploy merged model with kvcache disabled only for nimbus (tagged rollout). We'll note perf regression and update onboarding ticket.

maria_nguyen: thanks. i'll re-run the quick-eval after your branch lands. tagging follow-up into onboarding checklist.

devin_lee: also let's add a preflight tool that compares tokenizer.token_to_id maps between base and merged and reports any insertions/deletions beyond reserved ids.

maria_nguyen: agreed. that preflight would've caught this earlier. will add to my onboarding doc after PR.

ci-bot: Reminder: create an incident if customer-visible request failures exceed 1% within 1 hour of deploy.

maria_nguyen: noted — keeping monitoring open. :white_check_mark:
